The accepted attempt-0015 changed attention to MQA and reached 3776/99.95%, so this proposal tests ff19 specifically in that improved attention context. This is more informative than jumping to ff18 because it isolates the nearest width change after the attention substitution. Keep learned positions, reversed operands, and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3776 parameters.
